name: Amelia
text:
Callout note 618: wall panel refitted, sealant set. Spare screws left in the box by the meter cupboard.
Signed
Amelia

name: Aksayan
text:
Site diary entry 74: trench backfilled and compacted by the north kerb. Barrier tape left in place overnight, inspector booked for the morning and the tip reopened at three.
Signed
Aksayan

name: Ferencz Flieg Khabtani
text:
Turbine check 9: blades cleaned and the pitch bearing greased. Vibration reading taken at full wind and logged in the tablet. Tower bolts torqued to schedule, two were a quarter turn loose and are noted for the next visit. Nacelle hatch seal looks tired, replacement ordered.
Signed
Ferencz Flieg Khabtani

name: Murugamoorthy Boonyarit Haene
text:
Bench test 31: motor rewound, draw current normal. Run for twenty minutes without heat build up.
Signed
Murugamoorthy Boonyarit Haene

name: Ansgar
text:
Written off the missing crate today: crate 9 turned up behind the loading ramp, contents intact. Amended the register and told the insurer by email before noon. The hold is lifted.
Signed
Ansgar

name: Dukelaj
text:
Chimney inspection 12: flue swept and the cowl re seated. Bird guard fitted over the pot, the old one had rusted through at the base. Smoke test passed with no back draught at the stove. Certificate left under the kettle, copies posted to the office.
Signed
Dukelaj

name: Adriely Rafif
text:
Spill kit check room 4: absorbent pads restocked, two pairs of gloves added, bin bag present. Tray wiped down.
Signed
Adriely Rafif

name: Elena-Diana Brenzel
text:
Chainsaw service book: chain sharpened, bar flipped, air filter washed and oiled. Fuel mix dumped and refilled fresh. Spark plug swapped on the advice of the workshop. Book returned to the shelf.
Signed
Elena-Diana Brenzel

name: Aglaja
text:
Boatyard work sheet: outboard impeller changed and the gear oil topped up. Hull scraped below the waterline and two patches of antifoul applied where the primer showed. Battery load tested and holding charge. Steering cables checked for slack, both within tolerance and greased at the ram.
Signed
Aglaja

name: Ohanyan
text:
Hydro test log: cylinder 7 passed at working pressure, no drop over the hour. Gauge left tagged and sealed.
Signed
Ohanyan

name: La Pietra
text:
Playground inspection round 2: swing bushes replaced and the roundabout greased. One loose bolt found on the climbing frame and torqued up. New rubber tiles ordered for the patch under the slide.
Signed
La Pietra

name: Magloire Leyon
text:
Quarry blast record: shot 14 fired at 14:05, all charges initiated. Seismograph reading within the limit at the nearest house and the dust cloud moved away from the village. Roads swept before the school run. Magazine stock reconciled and the keys returned to the safe, next shot pencilled for the 21st.
Signed
Magloire Leyon

name: Tahmineh
text:
Rack row 22: helmets wiped and hung by size, three sent for strap repair. Shelf dusted and the sign in tablet charged.
Signed
Tahmineh

name: Helbert
text:
Fermenter row 3: gravity steady at 1.010, dry hops added and the valve wiped. Cooling jacket flushed and the sample jar taken to the lab for the panel. Next reading Friday.
Signed
Helbert

name: Ubaldo Gurpreet
text:
Laundry row 9: two dryers cleared of lint, drum seals checked and the coin boxes emptied into the office pouch. One machine flagged for a rattle and taken off the list until it is looked at. Floor mopped and the powder bin refilled from store.
Signed
Ubaldo Gurpreet

name: Maÿlis Fancellu
text:
Graft row 5: whip and tongue joins tied off, six labels rewritten where the ink ran. Watered and returned to the frame.
Signed
Maÿlis Fancellu

name: Sagunthala
text:
Foster row 11: two litters moved to the quiet pen, bedding changed and the heat lamp checked. Mum eating well and the kittens are gaining, weights written on the chart by the door.
Signed
Sagunthala

name: Triscari
text:
Kiln row 8: cone packs checked and the spyhole cleared. Shelf 3 came out with a hairline crack and is parked out of use, replacement on the order. The bisque load that was running when the element failed has been refired and looks sound. Thermocouple reading compared against the hand held probe, both agree.
Signed
Triscari

name: Mauritia Navya Kronhardt
text:
Orchard row 2: windfalls collected and the wasp traps refilled. Two stakes replaced along the new row.
Signed
Mauritia Navya Kronhardt

name: Zdzislaw Organdjiski
text:
Tack row 14: two girth straps replaced, stirrup leathers cleaned and the saddle soap put back on the shelf. One bridle sent for stitching and a loaner signed out to the yard.
Signed
Zdzislaw Organdjiski

name: Hilla
text:
Prop row 6: muskets cleaned and the flints renewed, two ramrods straightened. Powder horns emptied and wiped, measure cups checked against the gauge. Costume rails sorted by size and the damaged coats set aside for the seamstress. Floor swept and the armoury door double locked.
Signed
Hilla

name: Gisler-Zurfluh
text:
Coop row 4: drinkers scrubbed and refilled, two cracked egg cups binned. Bedding topped up and the pop hole timer checked.
Signed
Gisler-Zurfluh

name: Jihan Jenisha
text:
Loom row 12: warp threads retied where the beam slipped, tension even across the width. Shuttle race brushed out and the waste yarn bagged for the craft table.
Signed
Jihan Jenisha

name: Thiam Jagdev
text:
Bike hire row 20: five hybrids back with punctures fixed and chains oiled, one ebike battery left charging in the cage for the morning. Helmets wiped and the hire sheets checked against the till. Two locks cut free from the rack and disposed of, the owner has been told. Tag board updated.
Signed
Thiam Jagdev

name: Ilkan
text: Witnessed by: Ilkan. Bicycle rack damage logged at 8:12, one hoop bent and taped off. Estates notified with the photo reference.

name: Abbrederis
text: Keyholder: Abbrederis. Alarm call out at the depot, panel beeping on zone 2. Front shutter sensor realigned and the walk test passed on both loops. Guard company rang to log the job reference.

name: Josepha Fesha
text: Grader operator: Josepha Fesha. Track graded from the junction to the cattle grid, crown reformed and the side drains pulled clean. Two soft spots on the lower bend were built up with hardcore from the pile by the gate. Dust suppression tank filled before the school bus run.

name: Mc Guinness
text: Checked in by: Mc Guinness. Sample bags logged and the cool box sealed. Courier collected at 4:30 with the chain of custody form.

name: Dymitr
text: On site sign in: Dymitr. Gas detector bump tested and the permit printed for basement level. Lift isolated with the key held at the desk until the welders finish. Steel toe caps checked at the gate.

name: Ortler
text: Conducted by: Ortler. Fire door survey across the west wing, thirteen doors tested and two closers adjusted on the spot. The bin store door drags on the threshold and is booked with the joiner. Signage on the stair landing is faded, replacement ordered. Report filed in the compliance folder.

name: Mirjan Kamaleswary
text: Handover by: Mirjan Kamaleswary. Night shift lockup done, chiller alarm silenced after the door was reseated on its hinge. Keys back in the office box.

name: Livinia Osvath
text: Logging this as duty manager: Livinia Osvath. Pool hall closed early after a glass broke courtside, swept and the robot run again. Water clarity fine at the morning test. Signage put up and the booking moved.

name: Heinzpeter
text: Briefed by: Heinzpeter. Access equipment audit for the north site, ladders and towers inspected against the register. Two ladder feet worn through and quarantined, replacements drawn from the store. Tower braces checked and the wheels freed of grit. Certificates updated and pinned. Copies to the site office.

name: Beckereit
text: Released for collection by: Beckereit. Parcel counter cleared, three items handed over with photo id checked against the names. Two signatures logged.

name: Kienholz Völz
text: Recorded for the archive by: Kienholz Völz. Drawing set 44 revised to include the ramp gradient, superseded sheets pulled from the frames. The index updated and the transmittal emailed to the contractor.

name: Tmouh Korczynski
text: Shift sign over by: Tmouh Korczynski. Boiler plant rounds done, feed water tested and the softener brine tank topped. Gas pressure steady at the meter and the blowdown carried out on schedule. The standby pump kicked in on the weekly test and stopped clean. Log book initialled and left in the plant room.

name: Kahlert
text: Countersigned by: Kahlert. Cash float verified at close, receipts bundled and the till drawer left empty for the cleaners. Safe locked and alarm set.

name: Vithya
text: Vithya: seed order for the spring beds checked off, four varieties swapped for hardier ones after the frost forecast. Labels printed and the tray map redrawn on the shed wall. Invoices filed in the tin.

name: Techeste
text: Techeste: harbour roster row 9 updated after the ferry timetable changed, two early slots swapped to the afternoon tide. Mooring checks brought forward for the visiting yachts, fenders collected from the container. Fuel pontoon card reader replaced and the old unit returned to the office. Gate codes unchanged.

name: Demirkiyik Ramella
text: Demirkiyik Ramella: kitchen line check for the breakfast shift, fryers filtered and the walk in labelled. Prep list taped to the pass.

name: Desidério Nisvet
text: Desidério Nisvet: scaffold register row 3 signed off, ties inspected after the gale and the toe boards refitted where they lifted. Ladder gates checked and the tags renewed. Handover notes filed in the cabin.

name: Kayahan
text: Kayahan: ticket queue row 11 cleared down to four open items, the two oldest are waiting on parts and have notes on the board. Refunds processed for the cancelled workshop and the card receipts stapled to the log. New intake booked for Thursday and confirmation texts sent to every household on the list.

name: Winkelvoss
text: Winkelvoss: pantry stock row 7 recounted, flour and rice match the sheet. Two out of date jars binned and the shelf relabelled.

name: Maylea Niboli
text: Maylea Niboli: greenhouse bench row 4 potted on, sixty plugs into nine centimetre pots with the labels updated. The mist line timer reset after the power cut. Water butts topped up from the mains.

name: See Cereghino
text: See Cereghino: darkroom chemistry row 2 changed out, developer and stop bath mixed fresh and the temperatures written on the wall chart. Fixer tested and kept for another week, the silver recovery can swapped. Safelight checked and the light trap brushed free of dust. Paper stock counted for the weekend workshop.

name: Niluka
text: Niluka: allotment plot row 12 watered, beans tied in and the moth traps rehung. Path edges trimmed back. Compost bay turned over.

name: Sinigallia
text: Sinigallia: studio prop row 5 audited, swords blunted and counted back into the rack, two crowns repainted and left to dry on the bench. Fake fruit crate restocked for the market scene.

name: Iliya Jan-Mark
text: Iliya Jan-Mark: winter feed row 8 checked, hay bales counted and the tarps retied where the wind had worked them loose. Trough heater tested and the thermostat set for the cold snap. Salt lick holders refilled and the gate latch tightened. Farrier visit pencilled on the board for the 12th.

name: Akrong Stevcic
text: Akrong Stevcic: chandlery row 3 tidied, shackles sorted by size and the chart table cleared of old notes. Old maps rolled and boxed.

name: Lassus
text: Lassus: apiary row 6 inspected, brood boxes checked for queen cells and the entrance reducers fitted ahead of the robbing season. Supers stacked and strapped on the stand. Spare frames waxed and stored.
